title: department.v1.envelope
description: The mandatory envelope on every department record and event (Media Department charter v1 §4, idp#7395). Every field is required; a field that may be empty is declared nullable here and is made non-null by the transition that needs it (platform/department/contract.py TRANSITION_REQUIRES). Department-neutral: Media is the first instance, Research and Science reuse it (charter M7). A record is data a worker proposes; it is admitted only by contract.admit(), never by schema validity alone.

schema_version.description: major version of this family; a breaking change is department.v2 in a new directory (docs/departments/media/README.md, compatibility policy)

run_id.description: immutable reference this write is recorded under

source_ref.description: where the input came from: an issue, a commit path, an event id. Never empty.

source_revision.description: the revision of source_ref this record was derived from; checked against the current revision at admission (stale provenance is refused)

authority.description: the role the writer acts under; must be a role the department config grants that writer

door.description: the existing authorization door, e.g. founder.decision

kind.description: observation = read from a running system (a production log line, a probe); generated = produced by a model. A generated item is never accepted where an observation is required.
